Devayani Chandane - TY CS
INTERVIEW EXPERIENCE FOR
SUMMER INTERN

PPT
The pre placement talk was conducted on 1st September in online mode.Do attend the
PPT as it is crucial when you are asked company specific questions.Make note of
important points.The PPT contains info about the company’s values ,reach,
goals,employee commitments,internship program details and much more.
ONLINE TEST:
1.ONLINE ASSESSMENT
Eligibility: 6.5+ CPI. CS,IT and circuit branch students were eligible.No active backlogs.
Overview:The Test was conducted on SHL platform.The Test consisted of 4 sections.
There were sectional timers.You cannot switch between the section.There was no
negative marking.
a)Coding Round:
This section had two coding questions and 45 mins were allocated for this section.
1.Given an array of numbers, I had to find out the sum of individual digits of the numbers
and return an array.
Example:
arr[]={22,67,921,88}
Solution array : {4,13,12,16}
Approach:For each number ‘n’ in the array find n%10 , add it to the sum then divide n by
10. Continue till n!=0.
Push back the sum after each iteration.
I could pass 15/16 test cases.
2.Given a string we had to eliminate vowels(lower as well as uppercase) and return the
string.
Example:
2

String s=”ThisPlaceIsTooGood”
String res=”ThsPlcesTGd”
Approach: if(s[i]!=vowel) {res+=s[i]}
I could pass all the test cases.
I could complete the above questions in 25 minutes, so I submitted the section and
moved on to the next section.
b)DBMS:
There were 12 questions in this section and time allocated was 15 min.
Questions were related to simple DML commands(insert,update etc.) and extracting data
from the provided database. Level of questions was easy to moderate.
c)React:
There were 12 questions in this section and time allocated was 15 min.
I don’t remember the exact questions,but they were related to component
rendering,props etc.
d)Angular:
There were 12 questions in this section and time allocated was 15 min.
The test lasted for abouts 1½ hour.The results of the test were declared on 3rd
september at 10:15 pm. 20 students were shortlisted for the ICG role and 20 for PBWM
role. 10 were waitlisted.
TECHNICAL INTERVIEW:
As I was shortlisted for ICG role, our interviews began at 11:00 am on 4th Sep.The
interviews were conducted on zoom.My interviewer gave a brief introduction of himself
and then asked me to give mine. I told him about my techstack, the projects I’ve worked
with and the committees I’ve been a part of.He advised me to give a crisp introduction as
it went on for 4 minutes.
3

Then he asked me to describe one of the projects I’d mentioned on my resume.I
followed the STAR approach to explain the project.(Make sure to highlight a unique
feature and in what way you contributed to it).He asked me about hooks and redux.He
also asked me about debugging. This went on for about 8-9 minutes.
Next up,he told me he would be testing my analytical skills. He asked me a puzzle:
You have x number of mangoes, when you try to arrange them in 2 or 3 or 4 or 5 or 6
rows, one mango is always left out, but all the mangoes fit in 7 rows. (You need to find out
lcm of all the numbers before 7) .I wasn't familiar with this puzzle but after taking a hint
from him I could solve it. Later he asked me to optimize the solution,which again I
understood only when he gave me the hint. He asked me what is time complexity and
how to find it.The meet lasted for about half an hour.
I was anxious and nervous about the results as I couldn’t completely solve the puzzle on
my own. Only 4 students were shortlisted for the technical round 2, I wasn't one of them.
But then around 5:20 pm, I got a call from TPO CR saying “you’ve been shortlisted for the
HR round”. And the interview was scheduled at 5:30pm.
Total 6 students were shortlisted for HR round.
HR ROUND
I got ready in 5 minutes for the interview and rushed towards my laptop. The interviewer
was friendly and generous. He asked me about the first interview round and how it
went.Then he asked me about the project I had mentioned in my resume under the
achievements section. I described the project in detail and highlighted the key features
and in what way I brought life to the website through UI/UX.
Then he asked me about my interests other than academics.He also asked me about my
short term goals. I mentioned about improving my skills and exploring other domains like
ML.To that he cross-questioned, why do you want to do ML as you’ve applied for SDA
role. To that I replied, I just want to explore a new domain out of curiosity and
inquisitiveness, but I reassured him that I would obviously prioritize the techstack
required by the company. He was satisfied.
4

Rest of the questions were about my family background, my willingness to relocate to
Pune, any gov officials I was associated with etc.
Towards the end of the interview, he asked me if I had any questions. I asked about the
work culture and how a day in the life of intern looks like. The interview ended on a good
note.
I was confident about the interview but still a bit tense about the results. The results were
declared at 8:00 p.m. 5 out of 6 people were selected for ICG role,I was one of
them.Parallely, 5 out of 11 were selected for PBWM role.
RESOURCES:
Practice DSA questions on regular basis. Revise OS,OOPS,DBMS frequently .
DSA:
DSA sheet love babbar
Striver’s SDE sheet
Dynamic programming:Aditya Verma’s Playlist
OS:
Gate smashers playlist, Interviewbit(for interview questions).
DBMS:
Gate smashers playlist,Interviewbit(DBMS, SQL)
OOPS:
Love Babbar's Cheatsheet
Be prepared with a real life example for the four pillars of OOPS.
5

PREPARATION TIPS:
1.Give sufficient time to each subject while preparing.
2.Be confident.Even if you don’t know the exact solution try to explain your
logic/approach to the interviewer.
3.Be honest while including your technical skills in the resume as interviewer might ask
questions based on it.
4.Be well-versed with your project and techstack used. You should have good
knowledge of the features and working of your project. Explain your contribution in
detail.
5.Prepare well for the HR round. Go through some commonly asked HR questions.Note
down the important points mentioned during ppt, it will help you to answer the question
“why do you want to join citi?”. Express your honest thoughts while answering the
questions, you should seem genuine and interested in working with the company.
6.If you are asked to code a question during interview, explain your solution
simultaneously. Think out loud!
ALL THE BEST GUYS!!!
